headline: Fed Keeps Rates Steady as Powell Warns Iran Oil Shock Could Boost Inflation in 2026
summary: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged while Chair Jerome Powell warned that the rise in Iran-related oil prices could boost inflation in 2026. Investors are weighing prolonged high borrowing costs.
why: The Federal Reserve sets US benchmark interest rates, which shape borrowing costs, bond yields and equity valuations worldwide. Oil prices feed directly into inflation and therefore into rate expectations.
why_moved: The Fed held rates steady while flagging that higher oil prices from the Iran conflict could push inflation up, keeping borrowing costs elevated for longer.
